title: A Breath of Fresh Air for Molière: Detecting Molière Scattering using Jet Substructure Observables in Oxygen Collisions
summary: Ultra-relativistic oxygen-oxygen (OO) collisions are a promising arena in which to probe rare, large-angle, high momentum-transfer $2\rightarrow2$ Molière scatterings between energetic jet partons and quasiparticles in quark-gluon plasma (QGP). As a jet propagates through the droplet of QGP formed in the same collision, its constituents lose energy to and excite wakes in the medium, and may scatter off quark- and gluon-like quasiparticles in QGP.
